title: Exact definite integral of x*sin(x) over [0, pi]
objective: Verify by exact symbolic integration, with independent verification, that the definite integral of x*sin(x) over [0, pi] equals pi.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.derived_from: the hypothesis is a definite-integral claim: integrate_definite for every run

parameters.name: expression
parameters.derived_from: the integrand exactly as typed in the hypothesis: x*sin(x)

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.derived_from: the one free name in the expression: [x]

parameters.name: lower
parameters.derived_from: the interval's lower bound as typed: 0

parameters.name: upper
parameters.derived_from: the interval's upper bound as typed: pi

qoi.name: exact integral value
qoi.definition: the exact symbolic value of Integral(x*sin(x), (x, 0, pi))
qoi.how_extracted: the wrapper's verified symbolic result string (qoi_expression)

success_criterion.statement: The verified exact value equals pi (numerically 3.14159...), i.e. its numeric value exceeds 3.1.

regime.notes: One closed-form definite integral on one declared symbol, inside the wrapper's ruled S1 operation allowlist. Declared per the substrate contract's section-3 regime statement (Packet B Phase 1.0).

mini_experiment.expected_observation: state solved_verified with result pi; the independent quad cross-check agrees within 1e-8.

full_experiment.design: Extend to the integrand family x**n * sin(x) for n in 1..5 over [0, pi], one job per n, comparing each verified exact value to its closed form.
